failure_modes: Distribution shift makes past transitions misleading
gloss: Model an agent system's actions as a weighted state graph and plan backwards from a goal state
invariants: Edge weights come from observed harness data
State space is bounded enough to inspect
mechanism: Record metadata from an agentic harness (tool calls, context injections, commands to sub-agents) and build a decision graph in which each edge carries the probability that the system moves from one state to the next. Given a current state A and a desired state D, walk the graph backwards to find the likeliest path and steer the orchestration along it.
